title: The Deadline of the Green Zone
author: Cyrus Zhou
blurb: Cyrus Okafor, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
